dct_description_sm: This study examines how climatic extremes during winter 2010-2011 affected the traditional food system in Iqaluit, Nunavut. This winter was anomalous throughout the Canadian Arctic, which manifested locally via warmer temperatures and decreased ice coverage.

dct_title_s: Vulnerability of the traditional Inuit food system in Iqaluit, Nunavut
